zh.text: $KYMR Kymera Therapeutics- 我繼續發現許多醫療保健股票目前比許多科技股更具吸引力。醫療保健子行業正在發生漂亮的長期基底突破。雖然我預期科技股可以帶領下週反彈，但仍有一些障礙需要克服。選舉可以成為減少黨派之爭的正面力量，但如果利率尚未正式見頂，它們並不是許多人預期的市場清除事件。

en.text: $KYMR Kymera Therapeutics- I continue to find many HC stocks far more attractive than many within Tech these days. Beautiful long-term base breakouts are happening across sub-sectors within Healthcare. While I do anticipate Tech can lead the bounce into next week, it's got some wood to chop. Elections can be a positive force for Partisanship lessening, but they're not the market clearing event many expect if Rates haven't officially peaked yet.

zh.text: 烏克蘭通臀為 10.0%/年，高於其 5.0%/年目標。烏克蘭貨幣供應量（M3）以 14.6%/年增長，高於 Hanke 的黃金增長率 9.3%/年，該比率與 5%/年通臀目標一致。通臀故事 = 貨幣供應。

en.text: Ukraine's inflation came in at 10.0%/yr. That's ABOVE its target of 5.0%/yr. Ukraine's money supply (M3) is growing at 14.6%/yr, ABOVE Hanke's Golden Growth Rate of 9.3%/yr, a rate consistent with Ukraine's inflation target of 5%/yr. THE INFLATION STORY = A MONEY SUPPLY.

zh.text: 不。德國的TARGET2債權基本上是高債務外圍國家人為債息上限及貨幣大幅高估的對應物。這無法輕算消。若沒有這些債權，外圍貨幣已經大幅貶值，當然它們有一天仍可能這樣做…

en.text: No. Germany’s TARGET2 claims are basically the counterpart to artificial yield caps and big currency overvaluations on the high-debt periphery. There is no netting this out. Without these claims, periphery currencies would have devalued massively and of course they still might one day…

zh.text: 德州當選州長 Gina Hinojosa 表示她可以與 Elon Musk 有強有力的工作關係，但僅限於我們的條件。鑑於 $TSLA 和 $SPCX 已在德州大量投資，這聽起來更像是關於稅收減免和誰支付新電力基礎設施的談判，而不是試圖將他們趕出去。

en.text: Texas Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa says she can have a strong working relationship with Elon Musk but only on our terms. With $TSLA and $SPCX already heavily invested in Texas this sounds more like a negotiation over tax breaks and who pays for new power infrastructure than an attempt to push them out.
